mapper.select: select id, goods_id, goods_name, source, channel, original_price from sku where id > #{afterId} order by id limit #{limit}
select id, activity_id, state, draft_json from group_buy_activity_admin where id > #{afterId} order by id limit #{limit}
select id, activity_id, state, draft_json from group_buy_activity_admin where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update group_buy_activity_admin set draft_json = #{draftJson} where id = #{id} and state = 'DRAFT'
update group_buy_activity_admin set activity_id = #{activityId}, state = #{state} where id = #{id}

update sc_sku_activity m left join activity a on a.activity_id = m.activity_id set m.activity_id = #{activityId}, m.tiers_json = #{tiersJson}, m.update_time = now() where m.goods_id = #{goodsId} and m.source = #{source} and m.channel = #{channel} and (a.activity_id is null or a.status != 1 or a.opening_enabled = 0 or a.end_time < now()) and not exists ( select 1 from group_buy_team t where t.activity_id = m.activity_id and t.goods_id = m.goods_id and t.source = m.source and t.channel = m.channel and t.status = 0 and t.end_time >= now() )
mapper.insert: insert into sc_sku_activity (activity_id, goods_id, source, channel, tiers_json, create_time, update_time) values (#{activityId}, #{goodsId}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{tiersJson}, now(), now())
